assessment: Andrew cleared the queue this hour and the board is now unblocked on decisions and blocked only on hands. In the 53 minutes since c-0009 he approved the courier (e-000073) and the ZoltarStar join (e-000071) and answered the credentials decision (e-000072, defer and do not surface). So the finding that dominated c-0009 - orders written with no transport - has changed shape rather than closed: the courier is approved and its order file is now written, but ZoltarLead has no executor, which means the one order that would install the carrier has no carrier of its own. That is the bootstrap, and it is the whole remaining gap. Nothing else moved: origin/main in this clone still reads a3ad2ff against the board's a246ccf, FETCH_HEAD is 15.8 hours old, no courier receipt since 00:49 CDT, no executor receipts, gate still amber with zero blocking on the review protocol. Four order files now sit uncommitted in the clone including c-0002.1, whose 1-minute-bar window closes around 2026-09-16 - eight days, and it is the only irreversible clock on the board. ZoltarStar was deliberately not dispatched: the node has no clone, identity or executor, so an orders/zoltarstar/ file would only make the board show a delivery that cannot happen; the real carrier is the ready session brief in claude/join-zoltarstar.md, which Andrew pastes at that machine. Evidence discipline unchanged: zoltarone has been silent for 23.2 hours against an hourly beat and the plan depends on it, zoltargenesis and zoltartwo have no heartbeat file in git at all, so of four cards only zoltarlead is inside cadence, and none of that is an outage call from this clone.

items.title: The courier is approved but nothing on ZoltarLead can install it - the carrier order needs a human-started session, once.
items.why: c-0009.1 said the dispatch loop had no transport and named one approval as the fix. Andrew gave that approval at 15:21 CDT and the order file orders/zoltarlead/t-20260908-courier-zoltarlead.md is now written. It will not run. ZoltarLead has no executor in any git evidence - no fleet/bridge/inbox, no order-executor task, no receipt after 00:49 CDT - so the node that is supposed to receive the courier order is the one node with nothing to receive it. Every other dispatch on this board is downstream of it: c-0002.1 (irreversible, expires ~2026-09-16), t-20260908-executor-dispatch-branch on ZoltarOne, t-20260908-genesis-inventory on ZoltarGenesis. This is a five-minute unblock that is currently costing the build days, and it is the last hand-operated step in the loop - after the courier runs once, it carries everything, including its own successors.
items.acceptance: A Claude Code session on ZoltarLead runs orders/zoltarlead/t-20260908-courier-zoltarlead.md to completion. A later fire of this brain reads a courier receipt under fleet/receipts/zoltarlead/ stamped after 2026-09-08T16:00 CDT, sees .git/FETCH_HEAD less than 30 minutes old, and finds all four order files listed in state_snapshot.orders_uncommitted_in_clone present on origin/fleet/dispatch at a real sha. Until then, no dispatch event on this board may be read as work reaching a machine.
